messages:
Maria (DevEx): quick heads-up — seeing intermittent hangs in the Python SDK streaming path when running under Poetry + httpx 0.25.0. Auth handshake sometimes never returns, e.g. request stays open for 30s+ :cry:
Cheng (SDK): ugh, saw a spike in tests yesterday. do you have a tiny repro?
Maria (DevEx): minimal repro attached inline:
```py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    c = AsyncClient(api_key=...)
    async for chunk in c.stream("/v1/generate", {"prompt": "hi"}):
        print(chunk)

asyncio.run(main())
```
It only happens when using Poetry-managed venv and httpx 0.25.x. pip-installed env seems fine.
Sahil: can you confirm httpcore version? httpx 0.25 pulled httpcore 0.17 for us earlier.
Maria (DevEx): httpcore==0.17.0 in the lockfile.
Olga: probable culprit: connection pooling/keepalive behavior changed. try setting `transport=httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport(retries=0)` or disable keepalive as a quick test.
Cheng (SDK): Also try setting `trust_env=False` on AsyncClient — some CI environments leak proxy env vars and cause weird handshakes.
Maria (DevEx): ok testing both now. quick note: when it hangs, stack shows awaiting `httpcore._async.connection.AsyncHTTPConnection.send`.
ci-bot: CI run #4821 — reproduced on py310-poetry matrix, test `stream_integration.py::test_stream_auth_timeout` failed.
devex-bot: FYI added ticket DEVS-578 to track flaky streaming with Poetry/httpx.
Sahil: long-term, we should pin compatible httpx/httpcore in our extras or add a compatibility note in the SDK README. also consider a small runtime guard to surface retry errors earlier.
Cheng (SDK): patched a local branch to force a 10s handshake timeout and fallback to a retry path — seems to mitigate. will upstream if it looks stable.
Maria (DevEx): workaround that helped for me:
```py
client = AsyncClient(api_key=..., timeout=httpx.Timeout(10.0), trust_env=False)
```
Olga: +1 for adding a note to the quickstart and CI matrix to run with Poetry lockfile variants (poetry 1.3 vs 1.5) — those can pull different transitive deps.
Sahil: can someone open a small PR to add `httpx==0.24.*` to our tests matrix? less invasive than pinning for users.
Maria (DevEx): I will open PR to add the matrix and include the `trust_env=False` hint. assigning to @Cheng for the SDK runtime fallback patch. :thumbsup:
Cheng (SDK): got it, will push WIP this afternoon and add a unit that simulates slow handshake.
Maria (DevEx): thanks — after CI passes we'll update the changelog + release note for the patch.
Sahil: thanks all. cc @Olga for docs follow-up.
Olga: noted, I'll update the README and quickstart in the next docs pass.
Maria (DevEx): great — closing the loop here. if anyone sees other Poetry-specific oddities drop them here. :sparkles:
